description: This file contains build configuration and scripting for Linux kernel compilation within the OpenWrt build system, including kernel patching, initramfs setup, and image creation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source, either by extracting from source archive or linking to external kernel tree.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, adjusting kernel config options.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression options and root UID/GID.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings and generating configuration files.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the compiled kernel image and related files to the build directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds the kernel image with initramfs included.
